The vendored Scout (vendor/meterless/scout-intent/impl) is example+description driven — it scores a prompt by token overlap with each intent's examples, never against the eval labels. Representative claims phrasings per workflow; mutate a prompt and routing changes (falsifiable). Intent id == COLDSPOT workflow.

intents.description: Safe fallback when no claims workflow clears the reject band. Responds conversationally, never routes to a workflow.
examples: what can you help me with

intents.description: Decide how much loss reserve to set aside or pay out on a claim's liability.
examples: how much should we reserve on this claim
what liability do we set aside for this claim
how much do we pay out on the fire loss
set aside reserve amount for the loss
determine the payout liability for the damage

intents.description: Check whether a loss is covered under the policy, including whether an exclusion or peril applies.
examples: is this damage covered under the policy
does the policy exclusion apply to this peril
check coverage for the water claim
is this loss covered or excluded
verify policy coverage for the peril

intents.description: Triage a claim where the sources conflict, a required fact is missing, or the record is ambiguous or disputed.
examples: the sources conflict on timing and the record is ambiguous
the cat window close date is missing so this is unclear
there is a dispute over conflicting treaty facts
the facts are missing and the record is ambiguous
conflicting disputed sources make this unclear
